about: The secreta of the formulary “4th Sunday after Pentecost” in the 1962 Roman Missal.

seg.tr: Be appeased, we beseech You, O Lord, by accepting our offerings, and in Your kindness make even our rebellious wills turn to You. Through our Lord Jesus Christ, Thy Son, who liveth and reigneth with Thee in the unity of the Holy Ghost, God,
